verdict.line: You lose if you let him charge E into a wall near you; you win if you land the double Lunge before he turns and parry his empowered auto with W.

brief.thesis: This is a melee duel where Fiora's mobility and burst consistently out-trade Ornn's slower, cooldown-gated kit, which is why the measured data gives Fiora both the lane edge and the solo-kill edge at a 50.4% head-to-head over 1340 games. Ornn's only hard punish, E (Searing Charge), only knocks up if he collides with terrain, so almost the entire lane is decided by whether you let him fight you next to a wall.

theirWindow.when: You're near a wall, his E up
theirWindow.what: Searing Charge (E) deals damage to everything he passes through and, if he hits terrain while charging, erupts into a shockwave that knocks up and damages everyone around him. If he's lined up on a wall with you between him and it, back off the terrain line or hold W (Riposte) to eat the follow-up auto.

yourWindow.when: After your double Q lands clean
yourWindow.what: Lunge (Q) can be reactivated for a second dash within a couple seconds at no mana cost, so chain both hits into an auto, then pop E (Burst of Speed) — every attack or Lunge during it stacks Move Speed, letting you stick to him through his short-ranged kit and keep landing Duelist stacks.

start.why: 92.4% pick rate and 50.8% win rate over 1481 games; the sustain and AD let you take short trades off Q without needing to recall into his poke.

boots.why: 50.5% pick rate at 49.2% win rate over 710 games; Ornn's Q, W, and R all apply slows or Brittle setups for magic damage, so the tenacity and MR answer his control tools directly.

core.why: First item in the highest-sample core path (52.6% over 304 games); the sustain and cleave let you win extended trades once Duelist stacks are up.
Spellblade plus the move speed passive stacks with Burst of Speed (E) to keep you stuck to him through his short dashes.
Completes the top win-rate path; the damage-over-time conversion lets you survive his delayed Volcanic Rupture (Q) pillar burst and knock-up combos.

situational.when: you're snowballing lane and want a burst-shield item for isolated picks after Blade Waltz
the game goes long and you need siege/split-push power against his tank itemization
you want extra true-damage execute pressure once he's stacked resistances

runes.keystoneWhy: The 13.4%-pick, 55%-winrate page; the healing-and-adaptive-force scaling rewards exactly the extended melee trades this matchup wants. Master-tier Fiora players instead run Press the Attack across 13,801 games — better suited if you're confident landing clean all-in windows and want the burst amp instead of sustained healing.

summoners.why: 51.9% win rate at 77.7% pick rate; Ignite converts your solo-kill advantage into actual kills in a lane where you're already favored to win the duel. Flash+Teleport (47.3%, 19.7% pick) is the alternative if you'd rather use the lane to scale and roam off resets instead of forcing kills.

playing.title: Poke with single Q, not autos
playing.detail: Use the first Lunge (Q) to proc Duelist stacks and heal before he's in range to punish with Searing Charge (E); save the free second dash for when he commits.

playing.title: Hold W for his empowered auto
playing.detail: Riposte (W) parries his next basic attack and reflects magic damage; save it for the auto after Bellows Breath's (W) final gout applies Brittle, since that hit is his biggest damage spike.

playing.title: Respect walls once his E is up
playing.detail: Searing Charge (E) only knocks up if he collides with terrain mid-charge; track his position relative to walls before you commit to a trade.

playing.title: Chain both Lunges into one trade
playing.detail: Q's second activation is free within a couple seconds; use it to close the gap and land an extra auto rather than saving it as an escape.

playing.title: Pop E to stick through his dashes
playing.detail: Burst of Speed (E) stacks Move Speed on every attack or Lunge landed; use it to stay on top of him since his kit has no ranged disengage outside terrain.

playing.title: Save R for isolated burst, not waves
playing.detail: Blade Waltz (R) hits every nearby champion but deals reduced damage on repeat hits to the same target, so it's best spent finishing him 1v1 rather than chip damage into a minion wave.

playing.title: Avoid lingering near his Q pillar
playing.detail: Volcanic Rupture (Q) leaves a magma pillar at the fissure's end point after a delay; don't stand in that zone during an extended trade.

brief.patchCaveat: All win rates, pick rates, item paths, runes, and summoner spells above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning and trade timing are my own read of the ability kits.

stats.opponentTip: Keep your Conqueror stacks whiel using [Q] to strike [P] to gain lane control. Block Ornn’s Brittle+ basic attack or his (R) with your [W].
